grains.RAW.EMPLOYEE_DAILY: one row per employee per day (90 days)
grains.RAW.RECORDKEEPING: one row per employee (communication-channel capture snapshot)

freshness: MAX(EVENT_DATE) is an observation watermark; requestedAt is not freshness

required_capabilities.core_pipeline: Curated KPIs reconcile to a RAW recomputation (run_core.py checks this on every build)
required_capabilities.breach_risk_model: Snowflake ML CLASSIFICATION of P(confirmed policy breach in next 7 days) per employee, evaluated on an out-of-time holdout
required_capabilities.forecast_and_anomaly: 14-day bank-wide alert-volume FORECAST; after-hours messaging ANOMALY_DETECTION (train 75 days, detect last 15)
required_capabilities.search: Cortex Search SEARCH.SURVEILLANCE_SOP_SEARCH over synthetic alert-review SOPs (one per desk and detection rule)
required_capabilities.semantic_analytics: Semantic view APP.COMPLIANCE_ANALYTICS and Cortex Agent APP.COMPLIANCE_AGENT using analyst + search tools
required_capabilities.grounded_ai: Agent answers return generated SQL and SOP citations; the action memo uses only KPI, employee, detection-rule and risk rows
required_capabilities.quicksight: DIRECT_QUERY dashboard (employees, daily alerts, confirmed breaches by employee, conduct-breach risk, events loaded) through a read-only Snowflake service user
required_capabilities.quicksight_q: Amazon Q topic over the curated datasets for natural-language questions
required_capabilities.aws_ingestion: Amazon Data Firehose -> S3 -> Snowpipe AUTO_INGEST into RAW.LIVE_EVENTS
required_capabilities.notifications: APP.LIVE_EVENT_ALERT logs new ALERT events to APP.ALERT_LOG and emails via SYSTEM$SEND_EMAIL; alert and tasks suspended between demos
required_capabilities.orchestration: Task graph APP.TASK_REFRESH_CURATED -> APP.TASK_RESCORE_RISK run on demand (EXECUTE TASK)

aws.memo: Amazon Bedrock Claude Sonnet 4.5 via APP.BEDROCK_GENERATE
